exercises.instructionEn: Read the story. Episode 2: Face-to-face Encounter.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-EPIZODNI ESLANG (68-bet):
Sandra va David Afrikada piton
ovini suratga olmoqchi. Adamou
(ovchi) va o'g'li Abou bilan. David
ilon iniga juda yaqin bordi va
piton unga hujum qildi.


2-EPIZOD TARJIMASI:

1) Sandra: Yaxshimisan, David?
   David: Ha ... jarohat olmadim,
   faqat juda qo'rqdim! Piton meni
   tishlamoqchi bo'ldi, lekin
   kameramga urildi. Qanday ulkan
   ilon!

2) Abou: Ilon bezovta qilindi. Endi
   uni tutish xavfliroq bo'ladi.
   David: Pul bersangiz ham o'sha
   inga qaytib kirmasdim!

3) Abou: Agar otamning omadi kelsa,
   yonayotgan somon ilonning hujum
   qilishini to'xtatadi. U ilonni
   tutib, dumidan tortib chiqarishga
   harakat qiladi.

4) Sandra: Nima bo'lyapti? Adamou
   yaxshimi?
   Abou: Agar u yaxshi bo'lmasa,
   qichqirganini eshitardik!
   Tashvishlanma, Sandra, u buni
   yuzlab marta qilgan.

5) Adamou: Endi hujum qilishidan
   oldin boshini ushlashim kerak ...
   Sandra: Voy! U ulkan!
   David: Orqaga o'tir, Sandra! Sen
   u yerda tursang, Abou uni tuta
   olmaydi!

6) Abou: Voy, yo'q!
   David: Ehtiyot bo'l!

7) Sandra: Kechirasan, Abou! Men
   tufayli piton qochib ketdi.
   Abou: Hechqisi yo'q. Bugun
   ilonning omadi keldi - va BIZNING
   ham omadimiz keldi, chunki hech
   kim jarohat olmadi.


⚠ GRAMMATIKA - ShART GAPLARI:

  1-TUR (real):
  'If my father IS lucky, the straw
   WILL stop the snake.'
  'Abou CAN'T catch it if you STAND
   there.'

  2-TUR (xayoliy):
  'I WOULDN'T go back if you PAID
   me!'
  'If he WASN'T all right, we WOULD
   hear him shouting!'


⚠ 'FACE-TO-FACE':

  = yuzma-yuz.


⚠ 'AN ENCOUNTER':

  = uchrashuv (kutilmagan).


⚠ 'TO BE HURT':

  = jarohat olmoq.
  ⚠ hurt - hurt - hurt.


⚠ 'FRIGHTENED':

  = qo'rqqan.
  ⚠ 'frightening' = qo'rqinchli.


⚠ 'TO BITE':

  bit - bitten. = tishlamoq.


⚠ 'HUGE' = 'ENORMOUS':

  = ulkan.


⚠ 'TO DISTURB':

  = bezovta qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'has been disturbed' - passiv
  (1-epizod nomi 'Do not Disturb').


⚠ 'IF YOU PAID ME':

  = pul bersang ham (hech qachon).
  Idioma!


⚠ 'STRAW':

  = somon.


⚠ 'TO PULL OUT BY ITS TAIL':

  = dumidan tortib chiqarmoq.


⚠ 'HUNDREDS OF TIMES':

  = yuzlab marta.


⚠ 'TO MOVE BACK':

  = orqaga o'tmoq.


⚠ 'LOOK OUT!':

  = Ehtiyot bo'l! (xavf).


⚠ 'TO GET AWAY':

  = qochib ketmoq.


⚠ 'NEVER MIND':

  = Hechqisi yo'q.


⚠ 'BECAUSE OF ME':

  = men tufayli.
  ⚠ 'because of' + OT.

tasks.en: Read the story. Episode 2: Face-to-face Encounter.
Sandra: Are you all right, David? David: Yes ... I wasn't hurt, I was just very frightened! The python tried to bite me, but it hit my camera. What a huge snake!
tasks.uz: Sandra: Yaxshimisan, David? David: Ha ... jarohat olmadim, faqat juda qo'rqdim! Piton meni tishlamoqchi bo'ldi, lekin kameramga urildi. Qanday ulkan ilon!

tasks.en: Abou: The snake has been disturbed. It will be more dangerous to catch it now. David: I wouldn't go back into that hole if you paid me!
tasks.uz: Abou: Ilon bezovta qilindi. Endi uni tutish xavfliroq bo'ladi. David: Pul bersangiz ham o'sha inga qaytib kirmasdim!

tasks.en: Abou: If my father is lucky, the burning straw will stop the snake from attacking. He'll try to catch it and pull it out by its tail.
tasks.uz: Abou: Agar otamning omadi kelsa, yonayotgan somon ilonning hujum qilishini to'xtatadi. U ilonni tutib, dumidan tortib chiqarishga harakat qiladi.

tasks.en: Sandra: What's happening? Is Adamou all right? Abou: If he wasn't all right, we would hear him shouting! Don't worry, Sandra, he's done this hundreds of times.
tasks.uz: Sandra: Nima bo'lyapti? Adamou yaxshimi? Abou: Agar u yaxshi bo'lmasa, qichqirganini eshitardik! Tashvishlanma, Sandra, u buni yuzlab marta qilgan.
tasks.note: ⚠ 4-kadr. 2-tur shart: 'If he wasn't, we would hear'.

tasks.en: Adamou: Now I must hold its head before it can attack ... Sandra: Wow! It's enormous! David: Move back, Sandra! Abou can't catch it if you stand there!
tasks.uz: Adamou: Endi hujum qilishidan oldin boshini ushlashim kerak ... Sandra: Voy! U ulkan! David: Orqaga o'tir, Sandra! Sen u yerda tursang, Abou uni tuta olmaydi!

tasks.en: Abou: Oh, no! David: Look out!
tasks.uz: Abou: Voy, yo'q! David: Ehtiyot bo'l!

tasks.en: Sandra: I'm so sorry, Abou! Because of me, the python got away. Abou: Never mind. The snake was lucky today - and we're lucky, too, because nobody was hurt.
tasks.uz: Sandra: Kechirasan, Abou! Men tufayli piton qochib ketdi. Abou: Hechqisi yo'q. Bugun ilonning omadi keldi - va bizning ham omadimiz keldi, chunki hech kim jarohat olmadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and fill in these words: eats, catch, lives, sleep, spends, squeezes
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va ushbu so'zlarni qo'ying: eats, catch, lives, sleep, spends, squeezes
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

Pitonlar - katta ilonlar. Ular
janubi-sharqiy Osiyo, Avstraliya va
Afrikada uchraydi. Pitonlarning
ba'zi turlari 33 fut (10 m)
uzunlikka yetishi mumkin. Afrika tosh
pitoni Sahroi Kabirning shimolida
uchraydi va odatda 32 fut uzunlikda.
U yer ostidagi inlarda YAShAYDI va
kalamush, maymun va hatto yosh
antilopalarni YEYDI. U zaharli emas.
U kunduzni inida O'TKAZADI va
kechasi ov qiladi. U o'ljasini
tishlari bilan ushlaydi va tanasi
bilan asta-sekin SIQADI - to
bo'g'ilguncha. Quruq davrda, noyabr
va mart oralig'ida, ilonlar tuxum
qo'yadi yoki qishki UYQUGA KETADI.
Ular odatda yuz yoki undan ko'p
tuxum qo'yadi, urg'ochi piton ularga
ikki-uch oy g'amxo'rlik qiladi. Aynan
shu vaqtda piton ovchilari ularni
TUTADI. Bu xavfsiz ish emas, chunki
pitonlar tuxumlarini himoya qilganda
juda xavfli.


JAVOBLAR:
  1 lives  2 eats  3 spends
  4 squeezes  5 sleep  6 catch

  ⚠ 'the snakes ... SLEEP' - ko'plik,
  -S yo'q.
  ⚠ 'the python hunters CATCH' -
  ko'plik.


⚠ 'A SPECIES':

  = tur. Birlik = ko'plik.


⚠ 'A FOOT / FEET':

  = fut (30 sm). 33 feet ≈ 10 m.


⚠ 'POISONOUS':

  = zaharli.


⚠ 'PREY':

  = o'lja.


⚠ 'TO SQUEEZE':

  = siqmoq.


⚠ 'TO SUFFOCATE':

  = bo'g'ilmoq.


⚠ 'TO LAY EGGS':

  = tuxum qo'ymoq.
  ⚠ lay - laid - laid.


⚠ 'FEMALE':

  = urg'ochi. 'male' = erkak.


⚠ 'TO TAKE CARE OF':

  = g'amxo'rlik qilmoq.

JADVAL:

         narsa      odam      joy
  some   something  SOMEONE   somewhere
  any    ANYTHING   anyone    anywhere
  no     nothing    no one    NOWHERE


⚠ 'SOMEBODY' = 'SOMEONE',
  'ANYBODY' = 'ANYONE',
  'NOBODY' = 'NO ONE'.


⚠ 'NO ONE' - ikki so'z!
  ('nobody' - bir so'z.)

exercises.instructionEn: Use: some / any / no and their compounds
exercises.instructionUz: Ishlatilishi: some / any / no va ularning birikmalari
exercises.explanationUz:
SOME - ANY - NO QOIDASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SOME - IJOBIY GAPLARDA          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'There is SOMEONE in the garden.'
  something, someone, somewhere
  ⚠ Taklif/iltimos savollarida ham:
  'Would you like SOMETHING?'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ANY - INKOR va SAVOLDA          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'Is there ANYTHING in the
   fridge?'
  'There isn't ANYTHING left.'
  anything, anyone, anywhere


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  NO = NOT ANY                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'There is NO ONE in the room.'
  = 'There ISN'T ANYONE in the
     room.'
  nothing, no one, nowhere

  ⚠ IKKI INKOR XATO:
  'There isn't nothing' ✗
  'There isn't anything' ✓
  'There is nothing' ✓


⚠ 'COMPOUNDS':

  = birikmalar (some + thing).


⚠ 'LEFT':

  'There isn't anything LEFT' =
  hech narsa QOLMAGAN.

tasks.en: Use: some / any / no and their compounds
tasks.uz: Ishlatilishi: some / any / no va ularning birikmalari

tasks.en: We use some and its compounds in positive statements. There is someone in the garden.
tasks.uz: Some va uning birikmalarini ijobiy gaplarda ishlatamiz. Bog'da kimdir bor.

tasks.en: We use any and its compounds in negative sentences and questions. Is there anything in the fridge? There isn't anything left.
tasks.uz: Any va uning birikmalarini inkor gaplar va savollarda ishlatamiz. Muzlatgichda biror narsa bormi? Hech narsa qolmagan.

tasks.en: We use no and its compounds instead of not any. There is no one in the room. (= There isn't anyone in the room.)
tasks.uz: No va uning birikmalarini 'not any' o'rnida ishlatamiz. Xonada hech kim yo'q. (= Xonada hech kim yo'q.)
tasks.note: ⚠ nothing, no one, nowhere - fe'l IJOBIY.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 ANY - savol
  2 SOMETHING - ijobiy
  3 ANY - 'wasn't' (inkor)
  4 SOMEWHERE - ijobiy
  5 ANYONE - "didn't" (inkor)
  6 SOME - 'biscuits' (ot bor)
  7 NOTHING - 'hungry, but' -
    mantiq: yeyishga hech narsa yo'q
  8 ANYWHERE - "doesn't" (inkor)
  9 SOMEONE - ijobiy
  10 NO ONE - odam ('knows')


⚠ 6-BAND: 'SOME' yoki 'SOMETHING'?

  'some biscuits' - otdan OLDIN
  'some'.
  'something' - o'zi ot o'rnida,
  keyin ot kelmaydi.


⚠ 10-BAND: 'NOTHING' yoki 'NO ONE'?

  'knows' - bilish odamga xos →
  'NO ONE knows'.


⚠ 'TO CAUSE':

  = sabab bo'lmoq.


⚠ 'AN UMBRELLA':

  = soyabon.
